verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a cap table that updates automatically and links to every supporting document in a secured data room. Award agreements are tied to board consents, exercises and stock certificates, and option grants are managed with predefined vesting schedules. The data room and ASC 718 reporting support investor and auditor reliance, and convertible notes can be generated. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of share-class management, SAFE instruments specifically (only convertible notes are shown), documented investor or auditor access to the live cap table, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
